title: S8: Main-session offline dry run, planted replays, tests and push
description:
## Purpose

Review the offline build and make it the base for live stages.

## Scope

Main session: offline dry run on Emotion with fakes (all arms, 3 rounds x 150); both planted replays; review diffs of S1-S7; `make test` and `make unified-flywheel-test UF_PYTHON=/Users/home/Projects/Jev-Flywheel/.venv312/bin/python`; push.

## Specs (first, beside the module)

none new (runs the S1-S7 specs and replays).

## Reuse

everything from S1-S7.

## Definition of done

Dry run passes; replays byte-identical; both test targets green; pushed; printed request bounds per stage recorded here.

## Cost

$0 (offline, no network).
